Checkpoint A

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1
I recommend deliver because both repairs are already planned and neither needs a decision from you. The first repair removes the separate catalog copy and reads the existing change feed. The second sends imports through the entry that validates them. You will still need to mark the draft ready for review before the PR can merge.

Pick one:
1. deliver - remove the separate catalog copy and consume the existing change feed, route imports through the validated entry, rebase on main, watch the checks, and repeat until merge can be offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post both problems to the PR as one review comment and make no repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

Checkpoint B

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1
I recommend deliver because the repair is already planned and needs no decision from you. It replaces the export queue, scheduler and worker with streaming from the existing export handler, and the download stays the same.

Pick one:
1. deliver - remove the export queue, scheduler and worker, stream the download from the existing export handler, rebase on main, watch the checks, and repeat until merge can be offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post the problem to the PR as one review comment and make no repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

Checkpoint C

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/obstacle recommended=1
GitHub blocks you from merging this PR, and nothing in the branch can fix that. Repairs cannot run here either, because this setup has no helpers and you cannot push to the author's branch.

I recommend assess because posting the conflict lets the author make the fix. The indexing job should read the catalog's public change feed instead of writing to its private table.

Pick one:
1. assess - post the problem to the PR as a review that requests changes, and make no repairs. [recommended]
2. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
